metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow landed a 1 kill wonder? Valorant logic broke again
metadata.description:
Clicked like I owed rent and still got that 1 baffling kill.
Enemy probably questioning their life choices.
Pretending this was skill for 0.14 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a total mystery but kills sneak in!

Tap if your aim’s a happy accident but the kills still count!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
